title: The Needs of Cards and Beyond

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara where the Ethersworn aim to infuse every living thing with etherium.

entities.name: Ethersworn
aliases: the council of mages known as the Ethersworn
entities.description: A council of mages whose goal is to infuse every living thing on Esper with etherium.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: Aether-infused metal with which Esper's beings are enhanced.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of the Shards of Alara block, bringing back hellions, zombies and titanic creatures.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane with a Welsh-folklore-inspired tone of faeries, ouphes and noggles.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark counterpart of Lorwyn, whose dragons are slumber-disturbed folklore monsters.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose dragons are predator-tyrants.

relations.note: Aim to infuse every living thing on Esper with etherium.
